ns2:course.label: Middle Ages to Baroque
ns2:course.description: Literary, thematic, cultural, and bibliographical analysis of the major authors, works, genres, and movements in German literature from 750-1720. Same as MDVL 470. Prerequisite: GER 332 or equivalent.
